```csharp
public enum DetachStatus
```

`DetachStatus` is the value of `Status` in [DetachResult](../detach-result/). It is returned by [Logical Transform](../logical-transform/)'s `TryDetach` and `TryBakeToUnityTransformLossy`.

For the failure values, `TryDetach` leaves the Scene as it was.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Success` |  | Succeeded. For `TryDetach`, the bake to the Unity Transform and the removal of the Logical Transform are complete. |
| `AlreadyDetached` |  | The target has already been removed. |
| `FloatRangeExceeded` |  | The position or scale cannot be represented as `float`. |
| `InvalidHierarchy` |  | The target is in a forbidden placement (Logical Transform → plain Transform → Logical Transform). |
| `SingularParent` |  | When moving a direct child Logical Transform up one level, its world pose could not be kept (the parent cannot be inverted, for example because its scale is 0). |
| `ConversionFailed` |  | The world pose of a direct child Logical Transform could not be computed. |
